> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-29

# Summary
A one-post third batch of the Sep 29, 2026 AI-answer work. It covers post 15586 (/epoxy-pipe-lining/). The folder holds the before and after content, the live HTML and response headers, and the guarded apply script. No written notes; details come from file names and headers.

# Key findings
- The saved headers show OTTO serving the page from cache (OTTO cache HIT) on Sep 28.
- The Oct 12 indexing report lists /epoxy-pipe-lining/ as edited Sep 28 but not yet seen by Google, with indexing requested Oct 12.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `before/content-15586.html`, `after/content-15586.html`, `live.html`, `h.txt` (headers), `apply_b3.php`.
